verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a native bulk-edit capability or batch mutations. Bulk work is only implied: the GraphQL API and typed SDK let users script operations across many issues, published rate limits govern high-volume scripted calls, and import tooling handles bulk ingestion from other systems. Missing for 10: documented multi-select or bulk edit of issues in the UI, batch or bulk API mutations, agent-driven bulk updates across many items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
